name: ZSF_DS_METRIC_CALC
description: This table contains the source tables from which metrics will be computed in Sales Forecasting.

columns.name: METRIC_CALC_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for metric value

columns.name: METRIC_CODE
columns.description: Metric name as defined in ZSF_DS_METRIC_DEFN

columns.name: PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Period as defined in ZSF_DS_PERIOD.

columns.name: DIM1_KEY
columns.description: Foreign Key of the first metric dimension

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_CODE
columns.description: Foreign Key to ZSF_DS_METRIC_SRC. This column will contain the code corresponding to the forecast type for which this metric source is created

columns.name: DIM1_PARENT_KEY
columns.description: Parent reference of first metric dimension

columns.name: DIM1_ANC_PATH
columns.description: Ancestor path reference of first metric dimension.

columns.name: DIM1_ROOT_FLAG
columns.description: Y / NULL to indicate if the dimension key is the root of the hierarchy or not

columns.name: DIM2_KEY
columns.description: Foreign Key of the second metric dimension

columns.name: DIM2_PARENT_KEY
columns.description: Parent reference of second metric dimension.

columns.name: DIM2_ANC_PATH
columns.description: Ancestor path reference of second metric dimension.

columns.name: DIM2_ROOT_FLAG
columns.description: Y / NULL to indicate if the dimension key is the root of the hierarchy or not

columns.name: DIM3_KEY
columns.description: Foreign Key of the third metric dimension

columns.name: DIM3_PARENT_KEY
columns.description: Parent reference of third metric dimension.

columns.name: DIM3_ANC_PATH
columns.description: Ancestor path reference of third metric dimension.

columns.name: DIM3_ROOT_FLAG
columns.description: Y / NULL to indicate if the dimension key is the root of the hierarchy or not

columns.name: DIM4_KEY
columns.description: Foreign Key of the fourth metric dimension

columns.name: DIM4_PARENT_KEY
columns.description: Parent reference of fourth metric dimension.

columns.name: DIM4_ANC_PATH
columns.description: Ancestor path reference of fourth metric dimension.

columns.name: DIM4_ROOT_FLAG
columns.description: Y / NULL to indicate if the dimension key is the root of the hierarchy or not

columns.name: DIM5_KEY
columns.description: Foreign Key of the fifth metric dimension

columns.name: DIM5_PARENT_KEY
columns.description: Parent reference of fifth metric dimension.

columns.name: DIM5_ANC_PATH
columns.description: Ancestor path reference of fifth metric dimension.

columns.name: DIM5_ROOT_FLAG
columns.description: Y / NULL to indicate if the dimension key is the root of the hierarchy or not

columns.name: METRIC_VALUE
columns.description: Amount / Value of the metric. If the metric is an amount based metric, this column will contain the amount in Corporate Currency. If the metric is unit based (like Quantity based metrics), it will contain the number of units.

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_PK1
columns.description: PK value of first metric source table

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_OVN1
columns.description: OVN value of first metric source table

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_PK2
columns.description: PK value of second metric source table

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_OVN2
columns.description: OVN value of second metric source table

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_PK3
columns.description: PK value of third metric source table

columns.name: METRIC_SRC_OVN3
columns.description: OVN value of third metric source table

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.
